_comment: Incident-tuned trail-filter denylists (Epic 025). Compiled with re.I. See tests/test_trail_filter.py for the pinned behavior. `residential_street_suffix` lists the full USPS residential street-type set; `circle|place|terrace` were added for the dogfood-#2 class — TIGER-imported cul-de-sacs (Oak Circle, Peace and Quiet Circle, Wildwood Place; tiger:name_type Cir/Pl/Ter) that carry no numbered ref and so cleared every other gate. Deliberately still excludes `road` (real fire/dike roads end in Road).
